description: This file defines a PHP class CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand that extends a console Command class, used to create a database savepoint during testing or deployment processes. It includes methods to configure the command and execute it by invoking a service to create the savepoint, then reports success.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: A command class for creating a database savepoint, extending the base Command class with logic specific to creating savepoints with a specified name.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the string command name used in CLI to invoke this command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and required arguments for the CLI.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the action of creating a savepoint using DatabaseBackupService and reports success.
